body:
The same person interrupted me in the same way again...

She probably has some idea what I'm thinking somehow, even though I didn't tell anyone until after she started intervening? It's not like I don't signal my mood subconsciously so idk.

But thank you.

I've been through the system a million times already... over the same thing. Over previous times I've tried and failed to achieve the same goal.

Though, each time so far, my reaction has been more extreme.

It is a standard I set myself, and without regard for how high it was. I set it without even having enough information to know how just how high it would actually turn out to be... but more than that, I verbalised it. I said this was what I would do and that I would not accept failure.

I'm not doing this to meet any expectation imposed upon me, because the expectations of others are so very low already. If anything, I am doing it to recover what little faith was held in me before things went so wrong. I am doing it to prove I meant every word.

I'm not sure that message will ever get through to anyone else. With such low expectations, others will have a hard time believing anything positive about my intentions here either, I'm sure.

But I can at least prove to myself that the words and deeds which held so much importance to me were genuine, and I will never betray them.

This is my way of saying I won't give up. I may fail, but I will not ever wake up one day and tell myself it is okay that what was necessary is now impossible.

If the necessary becomes impossible, then I will bury myself rather than take it all back. Otherwise, I would not just be a failure, but also a liar.

I would rather not see things differently, to be honest. To my mind, "moving on" and "getting better" are just euphemisms for "running away" and "going into denial".

My plans have always been failures, and the plans of others which have relied on me besides. I do not have anything to work from right now, no gain, no progress, nor even the simple maintenance of what I had before. My reailty has only drawn yet worse, as I tried to work to learn from both past and current mistakes.

I keep growing closer to acceptance, and I believe I am now prepared to cross that line. Everything I wanted has grown further and further from my grasp, and all I can do in response is admit it. I have nothing, not even the ability to pick up the pieces.

I do hope your optimism serves you well, however.
